summary: Add notifications.AudienceSender (SendTx/Resolve) to send a notice to users, groups, roles, event participants, records and addresses in the caller transaction; event rules and explicit sends share the new AudienceResolver. Repositories may implement the optional notifications.DispatchFinder so replays return the first receipt. Rule-mode events may no longer use a DedupeKey starting with addressed:, which is reserved for explicit sends.
